jobs.description: Lead engineer for real-time notifications on Next360, the company's core payments platform, owning a Go microservice on AWS EKS end to end alongside security hardening of the Java authentication gateway.
contributions: Built nxt-msa-notifications from scratch, a Go microservice delivering real-time notifications for the Next360 payments platform at a p99 latency under 85ms.

Added /api/v2 versioning to the login and users microservices and rolled it out without taking the service down, running the old and new versions side by side so existing clients kept working through the migration.

Debugged a release-blocking login failure by testing against the live pods instead of the source code, and traced the broken OTP flow back to three separate misconfigurations that I fixed before they reached production.
Proposed and led the frontend migration from npm to pnpm, hardening the build supply chain and pre-empting the late-2026 npm CLI CVEs and Shai-Hulud package compromises.

jobs.description: Led the architecture, core software development, and multi-tenant infrastructure for BMS Intel, a large-scale Building Management System built with Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL.
contributions: Led the architecture and development of BMS Intel, a large-scale Building Management System with real-time industrial device control over WebSockets.
Architected core backend systems including work orders, UUID-tracked command execution, a centralized File Service, and a system-wide ID migration across 100+ files.
Implemented Passkey (WebAuthn) authentication with backup codes, using Redis to store device metadata for each registered passkey.
Scaled a multi-tenant admin platform and production infrastructure on Docker and CI/CD, supporting multiple products including Gridlock.

jobs.description: Built automated financial data extraction, PDF reporting, and invoice visualization interfaces using Django.
contributions: Built automated data pipelines generating structured PDF reports from financial account statements, with dynamic invoice interfaces in Django.
Introduced automated tests and streamlined environment setup, improving deployment reliability and developer onboarding.
